title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Timer T3489
entities.description: Timer used during ESM information request procedure. On expiry, the MME resends ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message and restarts timer.

entities.name: ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by MME to request ESM information from UE. Retransmitted on T3489 expiry.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message
entities.description: Message sent by MME to reject PDN connectivity procedure when ESM information is not received.

entities.name: ESM cause #53
entities.description: ESM cause value indicating 'ESM information not received' used in PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message.

entities.name: Procedure abort
entities.description: Action taken by MME on third T3489 expiry to abort ESM information procedure and release resources.

entities.name: Resource release
entities.description: MME releases any resources allocated for the ESM information procedure when procedure is aborted.

relations.description: Timer T3489 expiry triggers resending of ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message
MME resets and restarts timer T3489 on first and second expiry
Third expiry of timer T3489 triggers procedure abort
Procedure abort causes release of resources for the ESM information procedure
Procedure abort leads to rejection of associated PDN connectivity procedure via PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message includes ESM cause #53 'ESM information not received'
